gaps.sentence: Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.
run out OF something = have none left.

gaps.sentence: I had to turn ___ their invitation because I was ill.
gaps.explanation: turn down = reject an offer/invitation; turn up = appear.

gaps.sentence: The protesters set ___ at dawn from the village square.
gaps.explanation: set off/out = begin a journey; set up = establish.

gaps.sentence: Who will take ___ from the current director?
gaps.explanation: take over = take control of a job/company.

gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
She was brought ___ by her grandparents.
gaps.explanation: bring up a child = raise, educate them.

gaps.sentence: Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
